academy-hall.alt: The Academy hall under tall colored windows and great stars, with Vexana standing at left and Guinevere waving her whole arm at right.

first-place-trophy.alt: A gold trophy stands beside a glowing screen in Layla's lab, with a scowling drone above and a seedling under a glass dome.

ruined-rooftop.alt: Two small silhouettes on the corner of a rooftop under a purple sky, one sitting on the edge with her long hair blowing.

slk.alt: A Selrick trainee design sheet showing the dark blue uniform in three views, with the S.L.K mark and logo at the right.

vexanas-school-uniform.alt: Vexana in her Academy uniform of white blouse, black vest and purple skirt holds out a white glove, her staff in the other hand.
In the dark, Vexana in her Academy uniform holds her staff in one hand and takes the hand of Guinevere with the other.

big-display.alt: Students watch the big display in the dark Academy hall, which shows a four-pointed rift in pink and violet with a small figure flying at it.

changes-parents.alt: A framed photo on a lab desk shows Chang'e and her parents in white lab coats, smiling together.
Chang'e's parents stand in white lab coats, seen from behind, in a blinding light while a hand reaches up toward them.
Chang'e's parents hurry past burning buildings with her at their side while a black and gold Ender towers behind them.

main-stairs.alt: Selena swings down a bright Academy stairwell with her dragon machine while Guinevere and Vexana follow a few steps behind on the stairs.

child-in-the-barrel.alt: Seen from above, a small child sits crying in the rubble beside a barrel as a long shadow falls across her.

day-of-the-tree.alt: Guinevere lies on the grass with her head in Vexana's lap, grinning up as Vexana's white glove rests on her hair.

lesleys-birthday.alt: In a bright lab, Chang'e flings both arms out toward a red and gold rifle held in a steel ring while Lesley looks on.

obsidias-new-form.alt: Obsidia's new form, a tall figure of silver plate with magenta light in its joints, spreads vast magenta wings marked with dark eyes.

project-angel.alt: Rows of androids with animal ears stand still in a dark hall of tall windows, the Project Angel androids of Oro.

raid-at-the-domes-foot.alt: Out of gray smoke, Vexana reaches a white glove toward the viewer, her staff held low in her other hand.

test-match.alt: Layla stands in the white training corridor where she and Fanny fight the practice drones in the test match.

white-box.alt: Vexana's keepsake box stands open on her desk beside two felt dolls and a photo frame, while a gloved hand holds a phone showing Guinevere and Vexana.

bone-chains.alt: Selena hangs against a tall dark column, bound in jointed chains of bone, while Obsidia floats beside her with a long weapon.

city-where-six-stars-opened.alt: A winged figure raises one hand as red four-pointed stars open in a dark sky over a ruined gray land.

hall-of-white-windows.alt: A long hall of tall white windows where rows of androids with animal ears stand still in the dark.

investigation-room-corridor.alt: Guinevere and Vexana fight back to back against clawed Enders in the Investigation Room corridor.

breaking-of-angelas-shield.alt: Angela floats in the air with her arms spread above the Training Droid in a burst of pink and yellow flame.
